pages.text: Crystal Balls are known to be used for scrying or to foresee the future.

Using a filled $(l:crafts/waystone)Waystone$() on it will cause you to look upon the location from above, provided that said location is loaded. Using a filled $(l:crafts/taglock_kit)Taglock Kit$() on it will cause you to look through the victim's eyes, provided said victim is either the same creature as you, or if the victim is within 80 blocks from you or one of your kind.

Either method requires the location or victim to be on the same dimension, and be within 1024 blocks from the ball, though there are $(l:world/blighted_shacks)rumors$() of a crystal ball that does not have that specific restriction...
